result.stdout:
Dotisan - batteries-included ASP.NET Core + Vue scaffolding

Usage: dotisan <command> [arguments]

Commands:
  dotisan new <ProjectName>    Create a new Dotisan application
      Profiles: --profile minimal|identity|saas|maximal|custom
  dotisan make resource <Name>  Scaffold a resource (make:resource is a compatibility alias)
  dotisan make endpoint <Name>  Scaffold an endpoint
  dotisan make crud <Name>      Scaffold CRUD UI and API files
  dotisan add integration <Name>    Add an integration recipe
  dotisan remove integration <Name> Remove an integration recipe
  add:integration           Add an explicit integration recipe to the workspace.
  build                     Build the API and Vue frontend.
  dev                       Run the API and Vue development servers together.
  doctor                    Check workspace and production readiness.
  generate                  Generate frontend contract files from the compiled OpenAPI document.
  jobs                      Inspect generated background job configuration.
  mail                      Show or open the local Mailpit inbox.
  make:crud                 Create editable Vue CRUD files for a resource.
  make:endpoint             Create a single-file vertical endpoint.
  make:resource             Create a model and vertical CRUD endpoint slice.
  migrate                   Apply committed EF Core migrations.
  remove:integration        Remove an explicit integration recipe from the workspace.
  run                       Run the API using dotnet run.
  schedule                  Inspect generated recurring schedules.

Options: --version, --help
